theme: An open Sunday between two short calls.
greeting: Good afternoon, Dan — the day is largely yours. A quick reset with Mike opened it this morning, and the island's annual meeting closes it over Zoom at five.

needsAttention.title: Confirm you're at the island meeting
needsAttention.detail: Mark asked whether you're attending the 5 PM DIRA & DIBA meeting or giving a proxy for quorum. Your calendar says yes, so a one-line confirm stops him chasing votes.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Your top-priority travel task has sat since mid-September. A refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out the longer it waits.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December trip
needsAttention.detail: The December-break destination call was due Sept 30 and the booking window closed Oct 15. Six people over three weeks of holiday inventory gets thinner every day it slips.
